full_image_comparison.normalization_scope: The complete supported v30 kernel policy is serialized by the same installed libsepol. A fixed bound of four requires an exact byte cycle closing at its first image; the entire cycle is retained and its lexicographic minimum selected. Every member is independently checked against complete tables and supplemental readers. This does not claim raw serialization is a single-step fixed point.

limitations: This compares the independently captured actual live export after verifying the complete original transaction chain; it does not adopt policy or qualify a screenshot.
Root must separately and explicitly adopt the verified actual exported bytes.
The helper admits the actual v30 MLS conditional-free format; unknown rule kinds or nonempty conditional storage are rejected.
